hook: Your beach towel has jumbo jets landing over your head.
title: A Beach Where Jumbo Jets Land Overhead
description:
Maho Beach on Sint Maarten sits right beside the runway of Princess Juliana airport. Landing jets pass very low over the sand and swimmers. It is a real beach and a real airport.

#Shorts #Geography #MahoBeach
comment_prompt: Would you lie there? Yes or no
